decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing cycling creatures and spells to set up a powerful combo with Living End, which allows the player to bring back all creatures from their graveyard to the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption and protection cards like Force of Negation and Grief to control the game until the combo can be assembled. The key strategy is to cycle through the deck quickly to fill the graveyard and then cast Living End to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures in one turn.

The deck focuses on utilizing creature toolbox cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to search for and assemble combo pieces such as Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck also includes resilience and flexibility with cards like Endurance and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons to handle a variety of situations. The combination of sacrificing creatures for value with Yawgmoth and creating tokens with Grist enables the deck to generate advantage and execute its game plan efficiently, all while utilizing a range of creatures to control the battlefield.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo pieces of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to equip a huge creature with infect and deal lethal damage to the opponent. Using Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for the Hammer, along with Sigarda's Aid and Kaldra Compleat for additional support, the deck aims to win the game in just a few turns. With efficient mana sources like Ornithopter and Springleaf Drum, as well as protection from counterspells with Spell Pierce, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Heliod, Sun-Crowned and Spike Feeder. The deck aims to generate a large amount of life gain and +1/+1 counters to create an unstoppable creature, while also having access to disruption and tutoring with cards like Eladamri's Call and Ranger-Captain of Eos. The deck also includes acceleration through Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf, as well as card advantage and creature selection with cards like Collected Company. The mana base is designed to provide a mix of green and white mana sources for optimal casting of the deck's spells.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a winning combo without the need for traditional lands. By utilizing cards like Twiddle, Dream's Grip, and Vizier of Tumbling Sands along with mana-fixing cards like Manamorphose and Amulet of Vigor, the deck aims to generate enough mana to cast Goblin Charbelcher and activate its ability to deal damage. Recross the Paths and Sea Gate Restoration help find necessary pieces, while cards like Bala Ged Recovery and Turntimber Symbiosis provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck focuses on explosive plays and quick wins.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers and removal spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes various versatile creatures and spells to stabilize the board and generate card advantage. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to all colors needed for the deck's spells and to support the powerful planeswalkers and creatures. Overall, the deck aims to control the game's tempo, disrupt the opponent's plans, and eventually win through efficient removal and powerful threats.

This UR Aggro Modern deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent quickly with efficient threats like Murktide Regent, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Counterspell, Lightning Bolt, and Spell Pierce to control the game and protect its creatures. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Unholy Heat and Blood Moon provides additional utility and disruption against opposing strategies. The deck aims to win the game through a combination of early aggression and efficient spell-based disruption.

The deck focuses on using control elements and elemental creatures to outmaneuver the opponent and disrupt their game plan. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the deck aims to control the board and gain an advantage. The elemental creatures like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation provide a strong late-game presence and can overwhelm the opponent. With a variety of land cards and removal spells like Solitude and Fury, the deck can adapt to different situations and maintain control throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble UrzaTron, which consists of Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower, to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This mana is then used to cast powerful colorless threats such as Wurmcoil Engine, Sundering Titan, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes control elements like Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Oblivion Stone to manage the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana ramp and flexibility in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo using Stoneforge Mystic to fetch equipment like Colossus Hammer and Sigarda's Aid to quickly equip them onto creatures like Puresteel Paladin. The deck aims to deal massive damage quickly, especially with cards like Inkmoth Nexus and Kaldra Compleat. The deck also includes cards like Esper Sentinel and Urza's Saga for card advantage and additional threats. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful combo strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combination of cards like Indomitable Creativity, Wrenn and Six, and Dwarven Mine to quickly generate powerful tokens on the battlefield. It also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Archon of Cruelty to control the opponent's board and disrupt their game plan. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker adds consistency to the combo while Prismari Command and Prismatic Ending offer versatile removal options. The deck relies on creativity and strategic planning to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This combo deck focuses on quickly equipping creatures with powerful equipment like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to deal massive damage in a single turn. Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin help search for and equip the necessary pieces, while Urza's Saga provides additional utility in finding artifacts. The deck also includes protection in the form of Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes, allowing for an aggressive and versatile gameplay style that can overwhelm opponents with unexpected bursts of damage.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Ziatora's Proving Ground to generate advantage and disrupt opponent's plans, while also using spells like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures from the deck. The deck also includes a mix of versatile spells like Mana Leak, Spell Pierce, and Prismari Command to control the board and protect its combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in its approach to winning the game by combining different elements into a cohesive strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with abilities that can be searched for and put into play at instant speed using Chord of Calling. By sacrificing creatures and generating value with recursion cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can create a toolbox of different creatures to deal with a variety of threats. The deck aims to assemble combos like sacrificing persist creatures multiple times with Yawgmoth, or creating a loop with Geralf's Messenger and Blood Artist to drain the opponent's life total. Overall, the deck aims to be adaptable and resilient in the face of different matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using small, efficient creatures that can quickly build up a strong board presence. By utilizing cards that provide protection, evasion, and pump effects, the deck aims to consistently put pressure on the opponent and end the game swiftly. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Esper Sentinel and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar offers card advantage and further enhances the deck's ability to maintain dominance on the battlefield. The mana base ensures the deck can consistently deploy threats while utilizing utility lands for additional advantage.

The deck aims to quickly assemble Colossus Hammer or Kaldra Compleat onto Puresteel Paladin or Stoneforge Mystic to create a powerful threat. Sigarda's Aid and Urza's Saga help in tutoring and equipping the key pieces efficiently. The deck also includes Inkmoth Nexus for an alternate win condition and Esper Sentinel for disruption. The inclusion of cards like Shadowspear and Nettlecyst provide additional versatility and resilience. Overall, the deck focuses on a fast and resilient combo strategy to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

This deck focuses on quickly dropping Death's Shadow onto the battlefield and utilizing various spells to control the opponent's board while dealing damage. The key strategy is to use cards like Thoughtseize and Counterspell to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing cards like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch to remove threats. Tasigur, the Golden Fang and Murktide Regent provide additional threats on the board, keeping the pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to maintain control while dealing damage quickly and efficiently with Death's Shadow as the main win condition.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It uses control elements such as Oblivion Stone and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt opponents. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine to close out the game. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion for additional mana acceleration. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through efficient mana production and powerful threats.
